## The claim

P4-2a: all four MVP lanes (AlphaMissense, ESM1b, SpliceAI, REVEL) run end-to-end on the iteration-4 record set on the laptop in one day.

**Prediction if true.** Each of the four enabled cards in src/mva/zoo/models.toml can be fetched (or is already a warehouse column), is licensed for this use, and joins to results.it4_allele_records so that mva-zoo coverage reports a non-zero scored count for it.

**What would refute it.** Any one of the four cannot be fetched, licensed or joined — then that lane is replaced from the opt-A list and the substitution is recorded.

## Evidence

| # | Direction | Strength | Kind | Observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 135 | supports | 0.70 | measurement | All four MVP lanes ran end-to-end on the 39,286-record set in one day: AlphaMissense and SpliceAI as warehouse columns, REVEL live over VEP REST (52 of 200 alleles scored), ESM1b downloaded under MIT with its digest reproduced on two independent downloads, converted and joined. | `docs/iteration4/step-2/methodology/119-four-lanes-fetched-licensed-and-joined.md` |
| 136 | supports | 0.60 | measurement | AlphaMissense reported exactly 10,601 scored and SpliceAI exactly 32,534 — the pre-registered non-null counts of warehouse.it2_insilico_annotations — so the allele_id join between the record set and the warehouse is correct. | `docs/iteration4/step-2/methodology/119-four-lanes-fetched-licensed-and-joined.md` |
| 137 | refutes | 0.30 | measurement | ESM1b could not be joined as declared: the record set carries no UniProt accession and its hgvs_p is Ensembl-flavoured three-letter, so the lane only runs through a new gene-symbol bridge built during this run. | `docs/iteration4/step-2/methodology/119-four-lanes-fetched-licensed-and-joined.md` |
